verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own Exports API. You choose an export type and a date range, and the types cover customers, customer screening, screening and monitoring cases, profiles, payment screening cases, transaction monitoring cases and alerts, and transactions. The marketing page also says transaction data can be exported as CSV for use outside the platform. However, open file formats are evidenced only for transactions, and nothing documents an offboarding or data-deletion path, so the full 'export everything and leave' story is only partly shown. Missing for 10: confirmed open formats (e.g., CSV/JSON) for every export type, coverage of configurations and audit trails in bulk exports, a documented account exit or data-deletion process, and independent or hands-on corroboration of complete exports.
